chars.ISSA: ISSA: a Moroccan man around 28 with short black hair and a trimmed black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie under an open dark green bomber jacket, black jeans, white sneakers, a black backpack.
chars.IMAN: IMAN: a Moroccan woman around 26 with long dark wavy hair loose on her shoulders, wearing a deep red velvet long house dress and gold hoop earrings.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a cosy modern apartment living room in Tetouan, Morocco. IMAN sits on a beige sofa laughing happily, turned towards an empty spot next to her on the sofa where a man's brown leather jacket and a second tea glass lie. On the low table her smartphone lies face down, ignored, its screen glowing as it rings. Suspicious, cheeky mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modern office corridor in Tangier, Morocco, late afternoon. ISSA stands holding his smartphone to his ear, eyebrows raised, mouth open, anxious and confused, nobody answering. Glass office doors behind him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Tangier train station platform at dusk, a modern Moroccan train waiting. ISSA sits on a metal bench with his backpack, elbows on knees, staring at his phone, thinking hard, worried. Warm platform lights.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Medium close shot inside a train carriage at night: ISSA in a window seat looks down at his phone whose screen is completely black, frustrated and suspicious, frowning. Dark night outside the window with tiny lights.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a quiet night train carriage, ISSA has fallen asleep in his seat, head against the window, backpack on his lap, exhausted. Blue night light, empty seats around.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Early morning in a residential street of Tetouan, Morocco, white buildings with green shutters, soft pale dawn light. ISSA walks tiredly towards an apartment building entrance carrying his backpack, keys in his hand, yawning.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside an apartment building stairwell landing in Tetouan, in front of a wooden apartment door. ISSA holds his key near the lock but freezes, eyes wide, head turned towards the door, surprised because he hears voices inside.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same stairwell landing: ISSA presses his ear against the wooden apartment door, holding his breath, eyes wide with shock and growing suspicion, one hand flat on the door. Warm light leaking from under the door.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the apartment entrance hallway: ISSA stands frozen, jaw dropped, eyes huge in disbelief, staring at a closed frosted-glass interior door at the end of the hallway behind which two blurry shadows, a woman and a tall man, are visible laughing together. A pair of unfamiliar men's leather shoes sits on the floor by the door.
